proposal.rationale: Stage 1 locked, unfolding untouched. Denoising and hough_threshold_vertical again left at incumbent: the 10 vertical ring boundaries are correct and Example 2 (degrade g007: mask_r_low 3.80 with binary_threshold 155 -> depth_nan_ratio 0.98, ring_count_error 1, proxy 0.0) shows how fragile the radial gate is on this family. SAM parameters are also left alone this round because round 1 showed the gain came purely from detection while sam_fill_rate was exactly unchanged; changing templates now would confound attribution of the accepted direction. The overlay continues the accepted direction with the one untried lever in stage 4: lower binary_threshold from the default region to 112 so more of the faint chevron joint pixels survive binarisation and dilation, then use the remaining headroom on hough_threshold_oblique (27->25, lower bound) and maxLineGap_oblique (74->80, upper bound) so the short chevron arms link into oblique segments in the four ring columns that still fall back to 'assume'. pattern_tolerance is raised modestly 11->13 so the newly measured, slightly irregular centres still pass check_distance_pattern instead of being discarded. binary_threshold 112 is analogous to the non-degrading Example 1 (113, proxy stayed in the 0.65 band with ring_count_error 0 and nan ratio ~0.22) and far from the degrading Example 2 (155); Example 3 (improve) confirms the low-oblique/high-gap direction on this family. Joint analogy only; no per-parameter causal claim. Expected response: more oblique segments and fewer 'assume' centres, higher correspondence_f1@15 and lower chamfer, sam_fill_rate and ring_count_error unchanged. All values inside configs/bounds/complex.json.
